verdict.rationale: The product documents one-line installs: `npx skills@latest add mattpocock/skills`, `claude plugin install mattpocock-skills@claude-plugins-official` through Claude Code's official marketplace, and Codex/Copilot marketplace commands. A real runtime probe confirmed the npx path installs skill files non-interactively, and the docs say you install and then type a slash command. Missing for 10: hands-on confirmation that the installed skills are picked up in a fresh agent session (the probe only read back the SKILL.md file); Codex and Copilot each need two commands rather than one.

support.subject: As a developer, I can install a skill collection with one documented command — a package-manager one-liner, CLI, or in-agent marketplace command — and it is active in my next session

citations.quote: claude plugin install mattpocock-skills@claude-plugins-official ... Updates itself by default.
`claude plugins install mattpocock-skills` is now the documented route
the documented skills.sh install path works non-interactively, exactly as the README promises.
Install the ones you want, then type a slash command.
